tickets.title: Evaluate GCP vs AWS migration feasibility
tickets.description: Conduct a comprehensive feasibility study for migrating our AWS infrastructure to GCP. Evaluate cost savings, technical risk, team readiness, and migration timeline. Deliverable: Architecture Decision Record (ADR-001).

comments.author: priya_nair
comments.body: I've reviewed the cost analysis. The $84k/month AWS bill is accurate and trending upward. However, migration risk is real – we must budget for at least 6 months of parallel costs during transition.

comments.author: rohan_mehta
comments.body: GKE performance spike results added to the ticket (see attachment). GKE outperforms EKS by 22% in our latency benchmarks. This significantly changes the cost-benefit calculation in favour of GCP.

comments.author: arun_sharma
comments.body: ADR-001 published and approved by CTO. Decision: MIGRATE TO GCP. Phase 1 starts Q2 2023. Closing this ticket.

tickets.title: Phase 1 GCP Migration: GKE cluster provisioning and authentication-service
tickets.description: Phase 1 of the GCP migration. Scope: provision GKE cluster in us-central1, migrate authentication-service and API gateway from AWS (EKS + S3 + RDS) to GCP (GKE + GCS + Cloud SQL). Target completion: June 30, 2023.

comments.author: rohan_mehta
comments.body: GKE cluster provisioned in us-central1. Node pool: 3x n2-standard-4 nodes, autoscaling 3-10. VPC network configured with private GKE nodes.

comments.author: vikram_patel
comments.body: Authentication-service containerized and pushed to GCP Artifact Registry. Workload Identity configured. Ready for GKE deployment.

comments.author: rohan_mehta
comments.body: Authentication-service deployed to GKE staging. Latency benchmarks: p50=12ms, p99=45ms. Exceeds targets. Ready for production cutover.

comments.author: arun_sharma
comments.body: Phase 1 migration COMPLETE. Auth-service and API gateway live on GCP. AWS resources decommissioned. Actual cost: $12k migration spend, projected monthly savings: $31k. Closing epic.

tickets.title: CRITICAL: JWT token rotation race condition in authentication-service
tickets.description: CRITICAL SECURITY BUG: The JWT secret rotation in auth-service has a race condition. During the rotation window (approximately 200ms), concurrent requests can authenticate with both old and new secrets, creating a window for token confusion attacks. Must be fixed before GCP production deployment.

comments.author: divya_krishnan
comments.body: Root cause identified: two concurrent token validation threads read the secret value before rotation completes. Fix: implement distributed locking. I recommend Redis Redlock. Assigning to Vikram as auth-service owner.

comments.author: vikram_patel
comments.body: PR #89 raised with Redlock implementation. Tests pass. Requesting expedited review from Divya and Rohan. CVSSv3 Score: 8.1 (High).

comments.author: divya_krishnan
comments.body: PR #89 approved and merged. Issue resolved. Regression tests added. Closing ticket.

tickets.title: Migrate authentication-service storage: AWS S3 → Google Cloud Storage
tickets.description: Replace all AWS S3 calls in authentication-service with Google Cloud Storage (GCS). Remove boto3 dependency. Add google-cloud-storage library. Implement GCS IAM roles for Workload Identity authentication.

comments.author: rohan_mehta
comments.body: PR #89 merged. AWS S3 fully replaced with GCS in auth-service. All integration tests pass. Closing.

tickets.title: Provision GKE cluster – us-central1 region
tickets.description: Provision a production-grade GKE Autopilot cluster in us-central1. Configure: private nodes, VPC-native networking, Workload Identity, Cloud Armor, Binary Authorization.

comments.author: rohan_mehta
comments.body: GKE cluster provisioned. All configs applied via Terraform. Cluster health: GREEN. Closing.

tickets.title: Team GCP training & certification plan
tickets.description: Develop and execute a GCP training plan for the platform engineering team. Target: GCP Professional Cloud Architect certification for senior engineers by Q3 2023. Budget approved: $15k.

comments.author: divya_krishnan
comments.body: Raised concern to leadership: without adequate training, the GCP migration is high-risk. Proposed 3-month ramp-up. Approved by Arun.

comments.author: divya_krishnan
comments.body: Rohan Mehta and Vikram Patel enrolled in GCP Professional Cloud Architect course. Expected completion: August 2023.
